about: Documented Dimensional Rift attempts at the 15% bracket, and the 15% failures and 35% attempts that bound it, season 1. team_power is the power the Rift shows in its header, with 차원의 힘 applied (power_basis 'rift'); a formation-screen (lobby) figure never decides a Rift bracket, so posts that give only lobby power (서신우's level 2-4 guides at 4.1-4.3G, 롤로노아's level 19 and 23 trucks at 4.3G) are left out of this file and cited in README.md's Refresh 2026-10-03 section instead. bracket is the header power ÷ the level's recommended power in rift-levels.json, against the game's table (crumb.gg rift.json: 20% → 15, 40% → 35); on a row with no Rift power (power_basis null) it is the poster's own statement, and the app lists such a row with the attempts that bound the ranked clears, not among them. rift_power_level is the 차원의 힘 level when posted; battle screens don't show it. evidence: 'screenshot' when the post shows the result screen or the fight with its header; 'text' when only stated. standing: 'accepted' for a screenshot showing the header power and either the boss at 0.000% (a clear) or the clock run out with HP left (a failure); 'unverified' for text, for a screenshot that stops mid-fight, and for a screenshot whose header power isn't shown. deck names a curated deck when the lineup matches one or its stated variant.
